label: Huawei P60 Pro smartphone
description: Huawei P60 Pro — 6.67-inch flagship, Wi-Fi 6 (2.4/5 GHz) but LTE-only cellular; USB-C 3.1 with Ethernet over adapter.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz) — no 6 GHz, no Wi-Fi 6E. Cellular: LTE Cat 19 only; the Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 4G variant has the 5G modem disabled by sanctions, so model wwan0 as LTE despite flagship silicon. USB-C 3.1 Gen 1 with Ethernet adapter support (usb0). No Google services; HarmonyOS handles captive portals differently, worth noting for guest-Wi-Fi onboarding tests.
